Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.lead: These terms govern use of the Fakturio web service for issuing and managing invoices. By registering or using the service you acknowledge them.
Terms.footnote: We may update these terms when the service or legal requirements change. The current version is always on this page.

service.title: Service
service.body: Fakturio is software-as-a-service for issuing invoices, managing customers, tracking due dates, and related reports and exports.
service.body2: The service is not a substitute for tax, accounting or legal advice. You remain responsible for document content and statutory duties.

account.title: Account and access
account.body: You need an account with a valid email and password. Keep credentials confidential. Activity on the account is treated as yours unless you prove otherwise.
items: you provide accurate registration details,
you do not abuse the service (attacks, scraping, limit evasion),
we may temporarily restrict access if abuse is suspected.

dataResponsibility.title: Data and documents
dataResponsibility.body: Company, customer and invoice data you enter are your business data. You are responsible for accuracy, lawfulness and your right to process them.
dataResponsibility.body2: Personal data processing is described in the Privacy Policy.

availability.title: Availability and changes
availability.body: We aim for stable operation but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. We may perform maintenance, fix bugs and change features without unreasonably defeating the core purpose of the service.

fees.title: Pricing
fees.body: You may start free during beta / trial. If paid plans are introduced, we will publish prices in advance; changes apply only after explicit consent or new subscription terms.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is”. To the fullest extent permitted by law we are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or decisions made solely based on app outputs.
liability.body2: Tax and accounting consequences of invoices remain with the user (or their accountant).

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You may stop using the account at any time. We may terminate for material breach or prolonged abuse. After termination, backups required for security or legal duties may remain as described in the privacy notice.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the law of the Slovak Republic. Disputes should first be resolved amicably; otherwise Slovak courts have jurisdiction unless mandatory rules say otherwise.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms or the service go to the contact below. For product help use Contact & support.

Support.title: Contact & support
Support.lead: A money product needs a human contact path. Here’s how to reach us and what we cover.
Support.footnote: For critical outages we will add a public status page. For now, try signing in again or email us.

contact.title: How to contact us
contact.body: Email a short description, invoice number (if relevant), and browser/device. We reply on business days.

response.title: What to expect
response.body: Typical requests are handled within 1–2 business days. Security incidents get higher priority.

topics.title: What we can help with
items: sign-in and account,
company setup and VAT mode,
invoices, PDFs and accountant exports,
payment import and VS matching,
app bugs and suspected incidents.

status.title: Availability
status.body: If you cannot sign in or the API is down, try again later and let us know. A public status page will come with production operations.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.lead: This notice explains what personal data Fakturio processes, for which purposes, on which legal bases, and what rights you have under the GDPR.
Privacy.footnote: This document is an Article 13/14 GDPR information notice. We will update it when the controller or processing scope changes, including the effective date.

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller of personal data in connection with Fakturio is the entity listed below. For privacy questions, contact us using the email in this notice.

scope.title: Scope and data subjects
scope.body: This notice covers Fakturio users (registration, sign-in, company and document management) and people whose data you enter into the app (e.g. invoice customers).
scope.body2: When you process your clients’ data, you are typically an independent controller of that data. Fakturio provides the tool; you remain responsible for the lawfulness of invoice and customer content.

data.title: What we process
data.body: We process only data needed to provide the service:
items: Account: email, password (stored hashed only), first/last name, registration and last-activity timestamps.
Company: business and contact details, tax IDs, address, bank details, logo and invoice defaults.
Documents and workflow: invoices, line items, customers, payments, reminders, notes, reports and related audit logs.
Technical data: session cookie / access token, IP and diagnostic logs in a proportionate scope for security and operations.

purposes.title: Purposes
items: create and administer your user account,
provide invoicing features (PDFs, due dates, payment matching, reports),
secure the service, prevent abuse and handle incidents,
meet legal obligations where they arise from your use,
communicate about the service (technical notices, replies to requests).

legalBasis.title: Legal bases
legalBasis.body: Processing is based primarily on GDPR Article 6:
items: performance of a contract / steps prior to a contract (providing the service after registration),
legitimate interests (security, operations, abuse prevention) balanced against your rights,
consent (where we expressly ask for it, e.g. optional features),
legal obligation, where applicable.

recipients.title: Recipients and processors
recipients.body: We do not sell or publicly disclose your data. Trusted processors may process data only on our instructions (hosting, email infrastructure, monitoring), limited to what operations require.
recipients.body2: Data may be disclosed to public authorities when required by law.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes collected:
items: account and operational data — for the life of the account and a reasonable period after deletion (technical/security reasons),
invoicing and company data — according to your settings and statutory periods that may apply to your records,
security and diagnostic logs — shorter periods, typically months, unless longer retention is justified.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time.
rights.body2: Send requests to the contact above. You may also lodge a complaint with the Slovak Data Protection Authority (Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov SR).
rights.action: In the product: export and account deletion live under Profile → Personal data.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: Fakturio uses necessary cookies / browser storage for authentication (httpOnly session token), language and appearance. These are required for the service and do not need marketing consent.
cookies.body2: We do not use third-party advertising trackers. If analytics cookies are introduced later, we will ask for consent and update this notice.

security.title: Security
security.body: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures: encrypted transport (HTTPS), password hashing, access control and environment separation. No online service can guarantee absolute security.

transfers.title: Transfers outside the EU / EEA
transfers.body: Data is processed preferentially in the EU / EEA. If we use a provider outside that area, we will ensure an appropriate safeguard (e.g. Standard Contractual Clauses) and update this notice.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this notice when features, legal requirements or the controller change. The current version is always on this page; the effective date is shown in the header.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, rights requests or incident reports, email the address in the Controller section. We will respond within GDPR timelines.

Landing.heroLead: For freelancers and sole traders — issue invoices, track due dates, and keep cashflow under control.
Landing.heroTrust: No credit card · company setup in minutes
Landing.featuresLead: From draft to paid stamp — without juggling five tools.
Landing.featureInvoicesBody: Line items, rates and non-VAT payer mode — numbers and VS ready to send.
Landing.featurePaymentsBody: Import bank CSV and match by variable symbol.
Landing.featureRemindersBody: Overdue overview and jobs that won't let you forget.
Landing.featureCatalogBody: Recurring items with price and VAT — onto an invoice in one click.
Landing.featureReportsBody: Monthly revenue, aging and overview without spreadsheet chaos.
Landing.featureExportBody: CSV / PDF ready to hand over — no retyping.
Landing.audienceLead: Not an ERP. A tool for invoices, due dates and cashflow — built for Slovak practice.
Landing.audienceSzcoBody: Non-VAT payer, EUR, company ID and IBAN. Invoices without spreadsheets or Word templates.
Landing.audienceFreelanceBody: Repeat clients, service catalog and a clear view of who still owes you.
Landing.audienceTeamBody: One company, shared due-date overview and export for your accountant.
Landing.stepsTitle: Three steps and you can invoice
Landing.stepsLead: Onboarding takes minutes. The next invoice even less.
Landing.step1Body: Company ID, IBAN and VAT once — then they flow into every invoice.
Landing.step2Body: Buyer with address and contact. The next invoice is faster.
Landing.step3Body: Draft → issued → due → paid. VS matches payments.
Landing.compareTitle: Instead of Excel and Word templates
Landing.compareLead: A spreadsheet can do everything — until you forget VS, a rate, or who still owes you.
Landing.sampleTitle: An invoice clients and banks recognize
Landing.sampleLead: Number, VS, due date and payment strip — ready to send. No copy-paste into a PDF template.
Landing.samplePoint3: IBAN and QR ready to fill in
Landing.trustSkBody: Company ID, tax ID, IBAN, VS and EUR — no foreign template tweaks.
Landing.trustDataBody: Company records stay in your instance; the account is separate.
Landing.trustFreeBody: Start free. Company setup and first invoice in minutes.
Landing.faqLead: Short and direct — no marketing fluff.
Landing.faq1q: Is Fakturio right for sole traders?
Landing.faq1a: Yes — non-VAT payer mode, EUR, Slovak details and payment strip are ready for everyday use.
Landing.faq2a: Upload a bank CSV. We find issued invoices by VS and mark them paid.
Landing.faq3a: In your instance. Sign-in handles a secure account; company data stays with you.
Landing.faq4a: You can start for free now. Product plans come later — no hidden trial limits.
